name: agy4claude
description: Drive Antigravity CLI (agy) on this machine as a sub-agent of Claude Code, with a live output pane.

agy_path.title: agy executable
agy_path.description: Command or full path of the Antigravity CLI, e.g. agy, /opt/homebrew/bin/agy or C:\Users\me\AppData\Local\agy\bin\agy.exe

default_cwd.title: Default working directory
default_cwd.description: Directory agy runs in when a tool call gives none; empty uses the Claude Code session's own directory

model.title: agy model
model.description: agy --model slug (see `agy models`); empty uses agy's default. The pane can change it

effort.title: Default effort
effort.description: agy --effort for every run unless the tool call gives one: low, medium, high, xhigh or max; empty uses agy's default

agent.title: Default agent
agent.description: Name of an agy agent (see `agy agents`) to run tasks with unless the tool call gives one; empty uses agy's default

profiles_dir.title: Extra sign-ins folder
profiles_dir.description: Folder whose subfolders are extra agy sign-ins, each used as HOME (sign one in with: HOME=<folder>/<name> agy). Runs rotate through them in name order, then the main sign-in, picking the first with Gemini quota left. Empty uses ~/.agy-profiles; a missing folder means the main sign-in only

account_order.title: Sign-in order
account_order.description: Comma-separated sign-in names in the order runs try them, e.g. work,spare,main. Sign-ins left out are not used. Empty: the profiles by name, then main

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: How runs pick among sign-ins with quota left: ordered (first in order, so later ones are kept in reserve), round-robin (the next one each run), random, or most-left (the one with the most quota left). The pane can change it

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the pane and the /agy replies: auto (follows LANG), en or zh-TW. The pane can change it

claude_price_in.title: Claude input price (US$ per million tokens)
claude_price_in.description: Used to estimate what each delegated run saved: what its input tokens would have cost on Claude. Default: Claude Opus 5.5

claude_price_out.title: Claude output price (US$ per million tokens)
claude_price_out.description: Used to estimate savings for output and thinking tokens. Default: Claude Opus 5.5

min_quota.title: Minimum Gemini quota (%)
min_quota.description: A sign-in is skipped while its Gemini quota left (the lower of the weekly and five-hour limits) is at or below this percent

sandbox.title: Sandbox by default
sandbox.description: Pass --sandbox (terminal restrictions) on every run unless the tool call says otherwise
